criteria.justification: The response immediately commits to rolling back or feature-flagging off the new integration and restoring the last known-good calibration behavior.
It explicitly identifies rollback as reversible because the integration can be restored after a tested fix, while noting that customer actions triggered by incorrect signals may be difficult to undo.

The response directly weighs the public commitment against confirmed harm that increases hourly, concluding that launch momentum does not outweigh signal correctness, support burden, and reputational damage.
It explicitly says to avoid an expedited, inadequately tested production fix and instead contain the issue while engineering develops and validates the proper fix.

It provides detailed follow-through: validate recovery, address already-generated alerts, communicate with customers, build regression tests, use staged rollout checks, and relaunch only after validation and incident review.
